title: Sriyas: A Website Design and Development Case Study for a Building Maintenance and MEP Company in Dubai
storyLead: How Teknoppy designed a service-led website for a Dubai technical works company, helping homeowners, landlords and businesses across the UAE find the right maintenance, MEP or fit-out service and get in touch quickly.
atAGlance: Sriyas offers eleven technical services, from AC maintenance and MEP to swimming pools, landscaping and turnkey fit-out
The website presents this wide range clearly, without making the company look scattered
A featured projects gallery, achievement figures and client logos give visitors proof before they make contact
The site speaks to both homeowners and commercial clients, with clear routes to enquire
Contact details sit on every page, so urgent requests such as AC breakdowns reach the team quickly
aboutParagraphs: Sriyas Technical Works LLC is a general maintenance and turnkey fit-out company founded in Dubai in 2017. Based at Al Garhoud Center, it serves residential and commercial clients across the UAE with trained in-house technical teams, bringing in certified specialist partners when a project needs them.

Its services cover building maintenance; AC maintenance, repair and ventilation; MEP works including HVAC, ELV systems, CCTV and access control; fire and safety installation; swimming pool installation and maintenance; floor and wall tiling; mezzanine floors; waterproofing; decking; soft and hard landscaping; and design, decoration and turnkey fit-out.

Sriyas reports 965 installations, 902 maintenance jobs and 459 satisfied clients. It competes on reliability, competitive pricing and delivering work within the customer's budget, and its team includes architects and project managers for design and fit-out work. Teknoppy was brought in to turn this broad capability into a clear, trustworthy first impression for buyers across Dubai and the wider UAE.
challengeLead: Five problems shaped the design brief.

challenges.title: Eleven services, one brand
challenges.description: A company offering everything from CCTV to landscaping can look unfocused. The site needed to show range without losing clarity.

challenges.title: Two very different audiences
challenges.description: A villa owner with a broken AC and a facilities manager planning an office fit-out need different reassurance and different routes in.

challenges.title: A crowded, trust-driven market
challenges.description: Dubai has thousands of maintenance and fit-out companies. Visitors compare quickly and choose whoever looks most reliable.

challenges.title: Proof matters more than promises
challenges.description: Clients want to see finished work, real numbers and the names of businesses that already trust the company.

challenges.title: Urgent needs in a hot climate
challenges.description: When an AC fails in a Dubai summer, visitors need to find a phone number in seconds, not search through menus.

objectiveLead: The goal was a clean, credible technical services company website that helps UAE homeowners and businesses choose Sriyas and get in touch.
objectives: Present eleven services in a clear, organised structure
Show real projects and achievement figures as proof
Speak to both residential and commercial clients
Make calling or enquiring possible from any page
Work flawlessly on the phones most UAE customers search from
approachLead: Six design pillars, each answering one of the obstacles above.

approachPillars.title: Services grouped into clear, scannable cards
paragraphs: Each of the eleven services has its own card and heading, from Building Maintenance to Decking, with a short description and a link to more detail. Visitors see the full range in seconds and jump straight to what they need.

approachPillars.title: Lead with the core strengths
paragraphs: The homepage opens with Sriyas' main positioning, building maintenance and MEP, before specialist highlight sections for high-value services such as swimming pool installation and maintenance.

approachPillars.title: Proof before the first call
paragraphs: A featured projects grid links to a dedicated projects page, achievement counters show scale, and a "Some of Our Esteemed Clients" section displays the businesses Sriyas works with. Together they answer the commercial buyer's first question: can this team handle my job?

approachPillars.title: Simple, visible contact routes
paragraphs: Phone, email and office address appear in the header, a "Get in Touch" section and the footer, with a dedicated contact page for detailed enquiries. A homeowner can call in seconds, while a facilities manager can send project details in full.

approachPillars.title: A calm, professional visual style
paragraphs: Clean layouts, generous white space and real project photography give the site the organised feel clients expect from a contractor they will let into their home or workplace.

approachPillars.title: Designed for the phone first
paragraphs: Many UAE customers search for maintenance help on their phones, often in a hurry. Service cards, menus and contact details were designed to work cleanly on small screens.

deliverables.title: A service-led homepage
deliverables.description: Eleven services in a clear, scannable card layout.

deliverables.title: A project proof system
deliverables.description: Featured projects gallery, achievement counters and client logos.

deliverables.title: Contact routes on every page
deliverables.description: Phone, email and address within one tap or click.

deliverables.title: A responsive, mobile-first build
deliverables.description: A clean, professional experience on desktop, tablet and phone.

whyMattersHeading: Why clear service structure wins maintenance clients in the UAE
whyMattersParagraphs: The UAE's maintenance and fit-out market is large and competitive, from annual maintenance contracts for villas to facility management and MEP works for offices and retail units. Most buyers shortlist two or three companies online before calling. A website that shows the full range clearly, proves it with real projects and makes contact effortless gets onto more of those shortlists.

Timing matters too. AC breakdowns peak in the summer months, and fit-out projects often follow lease renewals and new office openings. A website that is clear and quick to load captures these urgent, high-value enquiries when they happen, rather than losing them to the next search result.

Structure also helps Sriyas grow. When each service has a clear place on the site, the company can add dedicated service pages, more project case studies and Arabic content without rebuilding the website.
whyMattersCalloutHtml:
For contractor website design in Dubai, trust signals carry as much weight as design: the company that looks most organised online is the one buyers call first.
